import sys, hashlib, re
sys.path.insert(0, '.')
from scripts.adapters.mission_evidence import _manifest_name

_NAME_RE = re.compile(r"^(?P<stem>[A-Za-z0-9_-]+)--(?P<digest>[0-9a-f]{12})\.json$")

def _parse(name):

    assert m is not None, f"unexpected: {name!r}"
    return m.group("stem"), m.group("digest")

# Test 1

stem, digest = _parse(_manifest_name(fid))

stem, digest = _parse(_manifest_name(fid))
assert stem == "weird-name-with-spaces", stem
assert set(stem) <= set("ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_")
assert digest == _expected_digest(fid)

# Test 3
fid = "feature/with spaces & symbols"
first = _manifest_name(fid); second = _manifest_name(fid)
assert first == second
stem, digest = _parse(first)
assert len(digest) == 12 and re.fullmatch(r"[0-9a-f]{12}", digest)
assert digest == _expected_digest(fid)
assert first == f"{stem}--{digest}.json"

# Test 4
fid = "!!!"
name = _manifest_name(fid)
stem, digest = _parse(name)
assert stem == "feature" and digest == _expected_digest(fid)
assert name == f"feature--{digest}.json"
print("ALL 4 TESTS PASS against live implementation")
EOF
